issue.title: Reconcile provider-disabled Launch Control PNG snapshot drift
issue.description: Proposed by phase bead sase-n4.5.3 during epic sase-n4.5 landing. On clean master eba0eab7 after just install, serial visual reproduction `.venv/bin/pytest -q -n 0 -m visual tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_models_panel.py::test_models_panel_provider_disabled_png_snapshot --maxfail=1` fails deterministically: 578/1,520,532 changed pixels (0.038013%), 564 material pixels (0.037092%) in models_panel_provider_disabled_120x40. Expected and actual are both 1482x1026; visible content appears unchanged at full-image inspection, while the diff reaches outer-frame/background chrome. Determine whether this is deterministic renderer/harness variance, stale golden output, or a real layout regression; inspect expected/actual/diff artifacts, fix the fixture or implementation if unstable, and accept only an intentional focused golden change. Verify this node and relevant Models-panel visual coverage. Distinct from closed broad drift sase-dl and closed different-node fixes sase-ma/sase-co.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-nq — sase-np and sase-nq are the same bead filed twice by sase-n4.5.land 25 seconds apart (2026-08-16 16:40:29 and 16:40:54) with identical titles, descriptions, and refs. Corroboration and root-cause analysis from sase-n8.land were recorded on sase-nq (the READY one); this draft should be closed as a duplicate rather than worked. Summary of that analysis: the drift is stale golden output, not renderer variance — commit 3c9df1182 (closed phase sase-m6.9) renamed ACE keymap labels and regenerated zero goldens, leaving 41/48 models-panel nodes and 6 base ACE nodes deterministically red on clean master.

payload.close_reason: Duplicate of sase-nq (filed 25s apart by sase-n4.5.land with identical title/description/refs, per sase-n8.land's RELATED note), and the underlying defect is now fixed on master f8b4ebb11. Verified in workspace sase_14 after a from-scratch 'just install': a serial '.venv/bin/pytest -q -n 0 -m visual tests/ace/tui/visual/' run reports 16 failed / 681 passed and test_models_panel_provider_disabled_png_snapshot is NOT among the failures. The stale-golden root cause sase-n8.land diagnosed (keymap-label rename in 3c9df1182 landing with zero regenerated goldens) was rebaselined by epic sase-m6's coordinated golden regeneration plus 563a67fb0 'fix(tui): complete the grouping-keymap migration in the visual lane'.
